operating_performance.text: Passengers rose by {{passengers.change@FY2025}} to {{passengers@FY2025}}, supported by a summer programme of new leisure routes.
Fuel made up {{fuel_share_of_costs@FY2025}} of costs, broadly unchanged on the prior year and in line with the peer median.
The company acquired previously leased Boeing 737-800 aircraft and exercised its option for additional 737 MAX 8 aircraft, which it says supports recurring cost savings.

peer_positioning.text: Norwegian sits in the middle of the low-cost group on EBITDA margin ({{ebitda_margin.peer_rank@2025}}), net leverage ({{net_leverage.peer_rank@2025}}) and gross leverage ({{gross_leverage.peer_rank@2025}}).

Interest coverage of {{interest_coverage@FY2025}}, FFO to debt of {{ffo_to_debt@FY2025}} and FCF to debt of {{fcf_to_debt@FY2025}} each rank {{interest_coverage.peer_rank@2025}} of the group and sit in line with the peer median.

Capex intensity of {{capex_intensity@FY2025}} is above the peer median of {{capex_intensity.peer_median@2025}}, while cash liquidity to revenue of {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2025}} is below the median of {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_median@2025}}.
Advance ticket cover of {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2025}} is the lowest of the group ({{advance_ticket_cover.peer_rank@2025}}), below the peer median of {{advance_ticket_cover.peer_median@2025}}.

watch_items.text: Leverage: net leverage rose by {{net_leverage.change@FY2025}} to {{net_leverage@FY2025}} as net debt grew by {{net_debt.change@FY2025}} to {{net_debt@FY2025}}, so the path of debt is the key sensitivity.

Cash generation: FCF to debt fell by {{fcf_to_debt.change@FY2025}} to {{fcf_to_debt@FY2025}}, with free cash flow down {{fcf.change@FY2025}} to {{fcf@FY2025}} as capital spending absorbed more of the cash generated.

Investment: capex intensity rose by {{capex_intensity.change@FY2025}} to {{capex_intensity@FY2025}}, above the peer median of {{capex_intensity.peer_median@2025}}, as the fleet renewal programme absorbs cash.

Customer prepayments: advance ticket cover of {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2025}} is below the peer median of {{advance_ticket_cover.peer_median@2025}}, so a smaller share of the cash buffer comes from forward bookings.
